subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which session label and token-usage fields should OpenClaw permit in user-visible overflow messages across channels?
rationale: Implementation cannot safely infer whether raw session keys may be disclosed or whether estimated precheck counts may be presented as exact context size and overage.

options.title: Redacted label and qualified counts
options.body: Show a channel-safe display label and clearly mark each count as observed or estimated, while retaining raw session keys only in logs.

options.title: Counts without session identity
options.body: Show model and qualified token-budget details but rely on the delivery channel to identify the affected session.

options.title: Full internal diagnostics
options.body: Expose the raw session key and detailed counts directly for maximum operator diagnosis despite the disclosure risk.

recommendation.title: Redacted label and qualified counts
recommendation.body: Show a channel-safe display label and clearly mark each count as observed or estimated, while retaining raw session keys only in logs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to the shared overflow recovery, token-snapshot, and user-visible explanation paths where the policy would be implemented.
